heading: Why Aligarh Chooses
subheading: A GST-verified, government-empanelled solar contractor with over 1,442 kWp installed across 431+ projects — built on transparent pricing and engineering compliance, not the lowest-quote race.

differentiators.title: Verified & Financially Stable
differentiators.desc: GSTIN-verified business, operating since 2020 with an annual turnover of ₹51 Lakh – ₹1 Crore. A track record you can check before you sign, not just a sales pitch.

differentiators.title: MNRE & UPNEDA Empanelled
differentiators.desc: Installations completed by an empanelled vendor — a mandatory requirement for your PM Surya Ghar and UPNEDA subsidy application to be approved, not rejected.

differentiators.title: Engineering-Grade Compliance
differentiators.desc: IS 3043 earthing, EN 50618 certified XLPE cabling, IP68 MC4 connectors, and CEA (2023) safety regulations followed on every installation — not just the parts you can see.

differentiators.title: Built for Aligarh's Heat
differentiators.desc: N-Type TOPCon and bifacial module options with superior temperature coefficients, engineered to lose less output during 44°C+ summer peaks than standard Mono PERC panels.

differentiators.title: Transparent, Customer-First Pricing
differentiators.desc: Customisable systems with clear, upfront discounting and EMI options — including collateral-free SBI Surya Ghar loans — so there are no surprises on your final invoice.

differentiators.title: Beyond Rooftop — Agricultural Solar
differentiators.desc: SHAKTI submersible solar pumps with VFD control, matching water output to real-time irradiance — insulating farmers from diesel costs and unreliable rural grid power.
